t: Google Engineer on His Sentient AI Claim

q.x: “The AI sentience debate is a distraction to the real problem. He risked losing his job because he feared that Google is preventing AI ethics research from happening, which could amount to ‘AI colonialism’.” [link]

desc:
Google Engineer Blake Lemoine joins Emily Chang to talk about some of the experiments he conducted that lead him to think that LaMDA was a sentient AI, and to explain why he is now on administrative leave. He's on "Bloomberg Technology."
#google #bots #artificialintelligence #technology 

Read more here:
https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2022-06-17/can-ai-gain-sentience-maybe-but-probably-no
